en: An old monochrome postcard view of a town square and adjoining street. On the left is a cobbled street lined with modest two‑story houses and shops. In the center foreground stands a corner building with shopfront signage. To the right is a larger ornate building with stepped gables and arched entryway, partly hidden by young trees planted in the square. The printed caption at the top identifies the scene as the marketplace and Zeitz Street in Groitzsch.
